source: docs/t14t_corrections/decision_packet.md (headings D-01 to D-09). An id that is not listed here is reported as UNCLASSIFIED_DECISION and keeps a floor from being COMPLETE.

D-01.meaning: escalator landing is not on verified slab (capsule opening or core)

D-02.meaning: core footprint has no floor slab on this level

D-03.meaning: lift lobby entry rotated away from the capsule opening; departs from the approved 1F symbol orientation

D-06.meaning: back-of-house route shares the public hall

D-08.meaning: T1 spiral ramp access points are not defined in the model
